# identity_resolver runtime dependencies.
#
# This file exists because PR #109 added `from rapidfuzz.distance import
# JaroWinkler` to normalise.py without declaring the dependency anywhere.
# CI runs identity_resolver/tests but installed only the contact_syncer,
# meeting_syncer and whatsapp_bridge requirement files, so the import failed
# at COLLECTION time and took every assistant_api test module down with it --
# 2 red pytest runs whose message ("No module named 'rapidfuzz'") looked like
# an infrastructure flake rather than a missing declaration.
#
# The package that imports a dependency is the package that declares it.
#
# 🔴 AND IT HAPPENED AGAIN, TWICE, IN THE SAME FILE THIS COMMENT GUARDS.
# MEASURED 2026-09-04 by building a clean venv from this file and importing
# identity_resolver.batch_resolver:
#
#     ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'phonenumbers'   normalise.py:6
#     ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'httpx'          resolver.py, batch_resolver.py
#
# Enumerated rather than added one-at-a-time as each import failed: the
# module-scope third-party imports across every file in this package are
# httpx, phonenumbers and rapidfuzz, and all three are now here. Chasing them
# one traceback at a time is how a list ends up one short again.
#
# It stayed invisible because every environment that runs this package --
# the installed venv, the developer's machine, the box -- already had all
# three from a sibling requirements file. A dependency list is only tested by
# an environment that has nothing.
httpx>=0.24,<1.0
phonenumbers>=8.13
rapidfuzz>=3.0,<4.0
